description: Resting orders on the user's exchange accounts, including protective stop-loss and take-profit orders (is_trigger = true), and trigger entries TradeHub holds (type TRIGGER_ENTRY, order_id req_…). Use to find an order_id to cancel or to confirm a stop is in place. Not for filled trades (use get_my_trade_history). Inputs: optional venue and symbol filters. Sizes in the base coin, prices in USD. Next: cancel_open_order(order_id).
name: get_my_open_orders
